00313 void UGen::constructMultichannel(const int numUGens, const UGen uGenArray[]) throw()
00314 {
00315     if(uGenArray == 0)
00316     {
00317         initInternal(numUGens);
00318         for(int i = 0; i < numUGens; i++)
00319         {
00320             internalUGens[i] = new NullUGenInternal();
00321         }
00322     }
00323     else
00324     {
00325         int totalChannels = 0;
00326         
00327         for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00328         {
00329             totalChannels += uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens;
00330         }
00331         
00332         initInternal(totalChannels);
00333         
00334         int channel = 0;
00335         
00336         for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00337         {
00338             for(int internalIndex = 0; internalIndex < uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens; internalIndex++)
00339             {           
00340                 internalUGens[channel++] = uGenArray[uGenIndex].getInternalUGen(internalIndex);
00341             }
00342         }
00343     }
00344 }

00510 UGen UGen::operator[] (IntArray const& indices) const throw()
00511 {   
00512     const int numChannels = indices.length();
00513     
00514     if(numChannels == 0)
00515         return null;
00516     else
00517     {
00518         UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00519         
00520         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00521         {
00522             const int index = indices[channel];
00523             
00524             if(index < 0 || index >= numInternalUGens) 
00525                 newInternals[channel] = getNullInternal();
00526             else
00527                 newInternals[channel] = getInternalUGen(index);
00528         }
00529         
00530         return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00531     }
00532 }

00597 UGen UGen::range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00598 {
00599     const int startIndexChecked = clip(startIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00600     const int endIndexChecked = clip(endIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00601     
00602     const int numChannels = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00603     
00604     if(numChannels <= 0)
00605         return null;
00606     else
00607     {
00608         UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00609         
00610         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00611         {
00612             newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i + startIndexChecked);
00613         }
00614         
00615         return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00616     }
00617 }

00634 void UGen::initInternal(const int numInternalUGensToInit) throw()
00635 {
00636     if(numInternalUGens > 0 && internalUGens != 0)
00637     {
00638         decrementInternals();
00639         delete [] internalUGens;
00640     }
00641     
00642     numInternalUGens = numInternalUGensToInit;
00643     internalUGens = new UGenInternal*[numInternalUGens];
00644 }

00654 void UGen::decrementInternals() const throw()

00662 UGen UGen::withNumChannels(const int numChannels, const bool addedChannelsWrap) const throw()
00663 {
00664     UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00665     
00666     if(addedChannelsWrap || (numChannels <= numInternalUGens))
00667     {
00668         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00669         {
00670             newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i % numInternalUGens);
00671         }
00672     }
00673     else
00674     {
00675         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00676         {
00677             newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i);
00678         }
00679         
00680         for(int i = numInternalUGens; i < numChannels; i++)
00681         {
00682             newInternals[i] = getNullInternal();
00683         }
00684     }
00685     
00686     return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00687 }

00938 void UGen::setInput(const float* block, const int blockSize, const int channel) throw()
00939 {
00940     if(block == 0 || channel < 0 || channel >= numInternalUGens) return;
00941     
00942     UGenInternal* internal = internalUGens[channel];
00943     RawInputUGenInternal* rawInputInternal = dynamic_cast<RawInputUGenInternal*> (internal);
00944     
00945     if(rawInputInternal == 0)
00946     {
00947         ProxyUGenInternal* proxyInternal = dynamic_cast<ProxyUGenInternal*> (internal);
00948         if(proxyInternal == 0) return;
00949         
00950         rawInputInternal = dynamic_cast<RawInputUGenInternal*> (proxyInternal->getOwner());
00951         if(rawInputInternal == 0) return;
00952     }
00953         
00954     rawInputInternal->setInput(block, channel);     
00955 }

01001 void UGen::steal(const bool forcedSteal) throw()
01002 {
01003     if(forcedSteal == true)
01004     {
01005         // just dispose the current UGens and set them to null
01006         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01007         {
01008             internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
01009             internalUGens[i] = (UGen::null).getInternalUGen(0);
01010         }
01011     }
01012     else
01013     {
01014         // allow the UGens to handle stealing more gracefully
01015         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01016         {
01017             internalUGens[i]->stealInternal();
01018         }       
01019     }
01020 }

01133 UGenArray UGen::group(const int size) const throw()
01134 {
01135     int outputSize = numInternalUGens / size;
01136     if(numInternalUGens % size != 0) outputSize++;
01137     
01138     UGenArray array(outputSize);
01139     
01140     int inputIndex = 0;
01141     
01142     for(int outputIndex = 0; outputIndex < outputSize; outputIndex++)
01143     {
01144         UGen item;
01145         
01146         for(int i = 0; i < size && inputIndex < numInternalUGens; i++, inputIndex++)
01147         {
01148             item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01149         }
01150         
01151         array.put(outputIndex, item);
01152     }
01153     
01154     return array;
01155 }
01156 
01157 UGenArray UGen::interleave(const int size) const throw()
01158 {   
01159     UGenArray array(size);
01160         
01161     for(int outputIndex = 0; outputIndex < size; outputIndex++)
01162     {
01163         UGen item;
01164         
01165         for(int inputIndex = outputIndex; inputIndex < numInternalUGens; inputIndex += size)
01166         {
01167             item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01168         }
01169         
01170         array.put(outputIndex, item);
01171     }
01172     
01173     return array;
01174 }

01202 UGen UGen::interleave(UGen const& rightOperand) const throw()
01203 {
01204     // need to check this...
01205     
01206     if(rightOperand.isNull())
01207         return *this;
01208     else if(isNull())
01209         return rightOperand;
01210     else
01211     {
01212         UGen interleavedChannels;
01213         int maxNumChannels;
01214         if(numInternalUGens > rightOperand.numInternalUGens)
01215             maxNumChannels = numInternalUGens;
01216         else
01217             maxNumChannels = rightOperand.numInternalUGens;
01218         
01219         for(int i = 0; i < maxNumChannels; i++)
01220         {
01221             interleavedChannels <<= wrapAt(i);
01222             interleavedChannels <<= rightOperand.wrapAt(i);
01223         }
01224         
01225         return interleavedChannels;
01226     }
01227 }
